title: Ten Autumns and One Left Lamp
subtitle: 出行与离别 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 出行与离别（社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与离别）
meta: 主题语境：出行与离别（社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与离别）　|　核心词汇：departure　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 departure 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1945 my great-uncle ① made a departure that no neighbour in the lane would have understood, and he said the making was the whole of the year. The ② departure, meaning the leaving and not the train, ran ten autumns and stayed unannounced; a departure, he said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left untold.

Every ③ departure in that house had the same left lamp beside it, and the ④ departure at the end, meaning the one they kept for the last of the autumn and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever mentioned twice. A departure, my grandmother said, is nine parts quiet and one part somebody willing to wait; my great-uncle said the waiting is the part that fills ten autumns.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the departure was the whole of the journey, meaning the train and not the leaving. The ⑥ departure, meaning the train and not any of that, is the only thing in a journey that everybody books and nobody explains; departure, she said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a leaving and a train. She said the train is the part they remember.

By 1954 the ⑦ departure had become a line in a timetable, and the timetable had become an argument about the left lamp. The ⑧ departure of the whole thing, my great-uncle wrote in October, was one house and ten autumns of leaving; departure, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to leave. She said the leaving was never mentioned.

The ⑨ departure I remember is the one at the end, which was taken in 1968 and is still described as the quietest in the house. A ⑩ departure, my grandmother said in 1970, is the only thing that improves by being remembered; every departure, she said, is a train that has agreed to look like a leaving. She said the train was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 离开；离去（指那栋房子里发生的那一次）
B. n. 离开（指那份离别本身，与那趟车相对）
C. 固定搭配：make a departure 作出一次离开
D. n. 离别（指秋末那一次）
E. n. 离别；出行（抽象总称，指一屋子人的离别之事）
F. n. 班次；发车（指时刻表上写到、被排定的那一趟）
G. n. 出发的班次（指旅程中预订的那趟车）
H. n. 班次（抽象总称，指人人预订却无人解释的那个）

items.q: made a departure that no neighbour in the lane would have understood
The departure, meaning the leaving and not the train
the departure was the whole of the journey
the departure had become a line in a timetable
The departure of the whole thing
A departure, my grandmother said in 1970

answers.why: make a departure 意为“作出一次离开”，1945 年伯祖父作出了一次巷子里没有一位邻居能理解的离开。
departure 意为“离开”，指那份离别本身而不是那趟车，它历经十个秋天而始终没有声张。
departure 意为“离开、离去”，指那栋房子里每一次离开，每一次旁边都留着同一盏灯。
departure 意为“离别”，指秋末那一次，是唯一有人提起过两次的。
departure 意为“出发的班次”，指旅程中预订的那趟车，母亲说这趟车就是那次旅程的全部。
departure 意为“班次”，指人人预订却无人解释的那个而不是那份离别本身，是旅程里人人都预订、却无人解释的东西。
departure 意为“班次、发车”，指时刻表上写到、被排定的那一趟，到 1954 年这趟出发成了时刻表里的一行。
departure 意为“离别、出行”，伯祖父十月写道，整件事的离别是一栋房子和十个秋天的离开。
departure 意为“离开”，我记得的是末尾那一次，1968 年成行，至今仍被说成屋里最安静的一次。
departure 为抽象总称，祖母 1970 年说，一次离别是唯一会因为被记起而变得更好的东西。
